Performance updates & statements

Where can I find my statements and reports?

Transaction confirmations can be found under Recent activity in App or on Web.
Stake Accumulate tax reports are prepared after the end of each financial year and emailed to customers once they are available.

How often do I receive updates on the fund?

Stake publishes a monthly performance report with updates on the Stake Accumulate Fund, including its performance and portfolio.

You can view the latest and previous reports on our Monthly Performance Report page.
